rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a pump device, including when the exact type is clear from context.

example.english: This pump is used to pump water.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 bam1 jung6 lei4 cau1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a fuel pump or petrol-station dispenser rather than a general-purpose pump.

example.english: Before getting fuel, check whether the fuel pump is working.
example.traditional: 入油之前要先睇吓個油泵有冇壞。
example.jyutping: jap6 jau4 zi1 cin4 jiu3 sin1 tai2 haa5 go3 jau4 bam1 jau5 mou5 waai6
